iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: IAEA Board demanded Iran declare and permit verification of remaining enriched uranium stocks; Iran still has not accounted for material believed to include roughly 440.9 kg enriched up to 60%, while prospective U.S.-Iran deal defers nuclear negotiations for 60 days.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Reuters reports U.S.-Iran peace text nearly finalized and oil fell, but Hormuz remains contested: Iran announced closure/threats while U.S. says commercial transits continue; warning shots/incidents and Israeli non-participation keep conventional-war risk imminent.

israel_lebanon.notes: Reuters reported Israeli strikes killed at least 13 in south Lebanon while Hezbollah claimed fresh attacks; Hezbollah rejection of a Washington ceasefire plan and Israel retaining freedom to act leave this front highly active.

russia_ukraine.notes: IAEA-linked reporting says Zaporizhzhia lost all off-site power after a substation attack, the 19th such outage, while the UN Security Council warned the war is at its deadliest point in four years.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: June 10 reporting said Pakistani air raids in Kunar/Khost/Paktika killed at least 13 people according to Taliban claims, while Pakistan claimed militant kills; risk remains high with no durable de-escalation signal.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Al Jazeera and Sudanese sources report RSF-attributed drone strikes around el-Obeid killing up to 23 and hitting residential/funeral/food-supply targets; Kordofan drone war is widening.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE

latest_news.headline: U.S.-Iran peace deal near, Hormuz still contested
latest_news.text: Reuters says Washington and Tehran signal a preliminary agreement could be signed within days; Iran claims victory and says its sword remains over Hormuz while U.S. officials say reopening is performance-based.

latest_news.headline: IAEA demands Iran uranium accounting
latest_news.text: IAEA Board passed a U.S./UK/France/Germany-backed resolution demanding Iran declare remaining enriched uranium stocks and allow inspectors to verify them without delay.

latest_news.headline: Oil falls after Trump cancels Iran strikes
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Brent settled lower after Trump canceled planned Iran strikes and said talks had advanced; U.S. military still reported commercial ships transiting Hormuz despite Iranian closure claims.

latest_news.headline: Zaporizhzhia loses all off-site power
latest_news.text: IAEA-linked reporting says an attack on a substation cut external power to Zaporizhzhia NPP, the 19th full off-site power loss, again forcing nuclear-safety reliance on backup systems.

latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes kill 13 in south Lebanon
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Israeli airstrikes killed at least 13 in south Lebanon while Hezbollah claimed new attacks against Israeli forces, keeping the Lebanon front hot.

latest_news.headline: Gaza strikes continue during Cairo talks
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera reported Israeli strikes killed Palestinians in Gaza as Egypt hosted renewed talks with Hamas and other factions to salvage the ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: Drone strikes kill up to 23 in el-Obeid
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera and local rights reporting say drone strikes hit residential areas, a funeral gathering and a food-supply truck in central Sudan; Emergency Lawyers blamed the RSF.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghanistan airstrike cycle persists
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera reported Taliban claims that Pakistani air raids killed civilians in Kunar, Khost and Paktika, while Pakistan claimed it killed Afghan fighters after TTP-linked attacks.

latest_news.headline: UN warns Ukraine war at deadliest point in four years
latest_news.text: UN Security Council briefing warned the Ukraine war is deadlier than at any point since Russia’s 2022 full-scale invasion, with members also citing nuclear-safety threats.
sources: United Nations Security Council press release

latest_news.headline: Taiwan coastal drill, no fresh blockade trigger
latest_news.text: Reuters reported Taiwan simulated destroying an invading Chinese force in a coastal drill; no credible fresh 24h PRC live-fire/blockade escalation was found in this scan.
